rationale: Panel is driven by three additive cross-sectional effects: short-horizon mean reversion (price below its 3-5d MA outperforms; ret(5) SR -0.90 standalone), a short-lookback volatility premium (std(10)-std(20) positive), and positive medium-lookback skewness (skew(120), positive across 40-120d lookbacks). Equal-weight cs_z composites of these legs form a broad stable plateau (train SR 1.1-1.35, IC ~0.006-0.007 across ~40 parameterizations), indicating the edge is structural rather than a tuning artifact. The three picks are plateau variants differing only in vol lookback (10 vs 20) and skew weight (1x vs 2x) to hedge parameter-selection risk.
